Text.Text: I am Quartermaster Ysa Morn. I supply the wall, the hunting lodge and the district kitchens, and I do it to the gram. If you can help me keep my shelves full, I have work for you.
Recovered goods are paid at the recovery rate, and I have counted it exactly. Here is your pay.
These are our sacks with our stamps on them. That is six of rice and four of eggs back on my shelves.

I am short of rice and eggs, and both were ours. The Neo-Crusaders raided the farm convoys and they are eating my inventory. I need you to bring me six Eshan White Rice and four Eshan Farm Eggs. You can take them from the Neo-Crusaders of the Winter Marches, the Battlegrounds or the Ruined Garrison, then bring them back to me.
Good. Bring me six Eshan White Rice and four Eshan Farm Eggs. You can get them from the Neo-Crusaders of the Winter Marches, the Battlegrounds or the Ruined Garrison.

I still need six Eshan White Rice and four Eshan Farm Eggs. You can get them from the Neo-Crusaders of the Winter Marches, the Battlegrounds or the Ruined Garrison. Bring them to me when you have them all.
The kitchens will be pleased. I am satisfied, which happens less often. Here is your pay.
The seal is unbroken on every jar, which is good. That is four of chili oil and four of pickled greens.

They want Red Chili Oil and Pickled Greens. The Thyrsian Exiles make both from an old recipe, and they make them better than we do. I need you to bring me four Eshan Red Chili Oil and four Eshan Pickled Greens. You can take them from the Thyrsian Exiles of the Battlegrounds, then bring them back to me.
Good. Bring me four Eshan Red Chili Oil and four Eshan Pickled Greens. You can get them from the Thyrsian Exiles of the Battlegrounds.
I still need four Eshan Red Chili Oil and four Eshan Pickled Greens. You can get them from the Thyrsian Exiles of the Battlegrounds. Bring them to me when you have them all.
This is paid at the recovery rate, and I counted it twice. Here is your pay.
It is all still packed in ice. The smugglers take better care of my food than my own porters do.

It goes off-world through the Scraplands. Smugglers in the caves buy our river fish and farm poultry from the raiders and ship it out. I need you to bring me five Eshan River-Fish Fillets and five Eshan Farm Poultry. You can take them from the Scrapyard Smugglers of the Scraplands Caves, then bring them back to me.
Good. Bring me five Eshan River-Fish Fillets and five Eshan Farm Poultry. You can get them from the Scrapyard Smugglers of the Scraplands Caves.
I still need five Eshan River-Fish Fillets and five Eshan Farm Poultry. You can get them from the Scrapyard Smugglers of the Scraplands Caves. Bring them to me when you have them all.
This is convoy protection, so it is paid from the convoy budget, and the books still balance. Here is your pay.
You are back, and two convoys have come in complete. I checked every crate. Did you kill all ten Scouts?

Their Scouts find them. They sit in the Winter Marches and count my wagons more carefully than my own clerks do. Without them, the raiders are back to guessing where my convoys are. I need you to kill ten Neo-Crusader Scouts in the Winter Marches, then come back to me here.
Good. Kill ten Neo-Crusader Scouts in the Winter Marches on Eshan, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill ten Neo-Crusader Scouts in the Winter Marches on Eshan. Come back to me when it is done.
You are paid in full, and I have counted it exactly. Here is your pay.
You are back, and I lost no cargo this week. I have never written that sentence before. Did you kill all ten Hunters?

The Neo-Crusader Hunters do the raiding. Their Scouts find a convoy and then the Hunters take it. Every Hunter killed is one less pair of hands on my wagons. I need you to kill ten Neo-Crusader Hunters in the Winter Marches, then come back to me here.
Good. Kill ten Neo-Crusader Hunters in the Winter Marches on Eshan, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill ten Neo-Crusader Hunters in the Winter Marches on Eshan. Come back to me when it is done.
Here is the fixed rate, exactly as agreed. The smugglers will be back, so return whenever you want another sweep.
You are back from the Scraplands. Did you kill twenty Scrapyard Smugglers on your sweep?

I pay a fixed rate, as often as you want the work. Every smuggler removed from those caves is a crate of mine that stays on Eshan. For each sweep I need you to kill twenty Scrapyard Smugglers in the Scraplands Caves, then come back to me for your pay.
Good. Kill twenty Scrapyard Smugglers in the Scraplands Caves on Eshan, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill twenty Scrapyard Smugglers in the Scraplands Caves on Eshan. Come back to me when it is done.
Good. Take that number straight back to Captain Voss, and do not let him change it.
Did he? The wall has nine days of rations. That is exactly nine, not ten. Tell him that if he rounds it up in his report, I will know.
Good. Take that figure back to Huntmaster Ryl, and make sure he hears the part about curing.
The city wants two hundred hides this winter. Tell Ryl they are to be properly cured this year, because last year's smelled.
Goodbye, Quartermaster. Keep the count exact.
What other supply work do you have?
I am glad the food is back.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll bring back six White Rice and four Farm Eggs.
Not right now. I have other things to do.
What supplies are you short of?
I have all the rice and eggs you asked for.
I do not have all the rice and eggs yet.
Remind me what rations you need recovered.
I hope the kitchens enjoy them.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll bring four Red Chili Oil and four Pickled Greens.
Not right now. I won't rob exiles for pickles.
Do the district kitchens want anything unusual?
I have all the chili oil and pickled greens.
I do not have all the jars yet.
Remind me what the kitchens want from the Exiles.
At least it is back where it belongs.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll bring five River-Fish Fillets and five Farm Poultry.
Not right now. Smugglers are not my concern.
Where does the stolen food end up?
I have all the fish and poultry you asked for.
I do not have all the fish and poultry yet.
Remind me what food the smugglers have of yours.
Yes, all ten Scouts are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. I will kill ten Neo-Crusader Scouts.
Not right now. You could change the route.
How do the raiders find your convoys?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Scouts watching your convoys.
Yes, all ten Hunters are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. I will kill ten Neo-Crusader Hunters.
Not right now. You could hire more guards.
Who is raiding your convoys?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Hunters raiding your convoys.
Yes, twenty Scrapyard Smugglers are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll sweep the caves. Twenty Scrapyard Smugglers.
Not right now. Maybe another time.
Do you pay for sweeps of the Scraplands Caves?
Still working on it.
Remind me what the Scraplands sweep involves.
Exactly nine days. I will tell him.
Not right now.
Captain Voss sent me to ask how many days of rations the wall has.
Two hundred hides, properly cured. I will tell him.
Not right now.
Huntmaster Ryl sent me to ask how many hides the city wants.
